name: Ait Benhaddou up to the granary
why: Across the river and up the lanes of a fortified mud village, a World Heritage site and film set, to the old granary at the top over the desert road.
book: Small fee to enter some houses.
dangers: Heat from June to September: walk early, carry 2-3 litres.

points.name: Aït Benhaddou village
points.note: The new village across the river.

points.name: Aït Benhaddou granary
points.note: The ruined granary at the top of the ksar.
